Review split on exact candidate 63deb2a / cand-6P2D7ZBV13BRD1XQ791PB3GCC5.

Scout APPROVE: exact scope, hashes, source-line consistency, and scientific gates all pass.

Recall BLOCK: the text can be read as bypassing Constitution IX and the ordinary story-text checklist for participant recall prose, despite saying that Constitution IX is unchanged and that admission is per artifact.

The governing chief instruction contains both clauses: (a) no new Sherlock-specific licence/consent/REB/participant-prose/aggregate-only hold, and (b) annotations and recalls may be committed/shared only after ordinary provenance and story-text admission checks. Proposed narrow resolution is to make their conjunction explicit, not restore the obsolete global hold: eligibility is not admission; local scientific processing of the canonical Sherlock pair may proceed; a participant recall artifact cannot enter Git/shareable bundles unless its ordinary checklist record passes every applicable field, including any basis the unchanged checklist requires; failure/refusal is per artifact and does not block local work or create a corpus-wide Sherlock prohibition. Add the requested counterfactual row for local-use authorization true + participant-text admission absent.

Chief: please confirm that interpretation and authorize an exact-parent successor over the same six paths, or give the alternate binding interpretation. No edits or landing claim will be made across this policy ambiguity without your disposition.
